title: FAR 52.216-7, Allowable Cost and Payment
publication_date_or_edition: Clause August 2018; page displays FAC 2026-01 effective March 13, 2026
questions: How does a cost-reimbursement contractor bill allowable incurred costs?
How do billing rates and year-end actual rates true up?
inspected_summary: The clause separates interim billing rates from final annual rates. Its adequate-proposal list includes claimed cost pools and bases, general-ledger reconciliation, contract costs claimed and billed, and payroll-to-labor reconciliation. Final settled rates require updated billings; reimbursement remains subject to the executed contract and allowable-cost limits.
